{{Quote|May I present Lama Su, Prime Minister of Kamino.|[[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
'''Lama Su''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who hailed from a [[Species/Legends|race]] of [[Clone Master/Legends|expert cloners]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. As [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], he personally oversaw the creation of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|new army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;from [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Although Kamino's contribution to the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] gained Lama Su's people a [[Senator/Legends|seat]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], their actions were also partially responsible for the [[Order 66/Legends|systematic extermination]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yes, a clone army; and I must say, one of the finest we've ever created.|Lama Su|<ref name="EpisodeII" />}}
By the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Lama Su was the [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and thus he also served as the leader of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Ruling Council (Kamino)/Legends|Ruling Council]] of Colony [[Governor/Legends|Governors]].<ref name="db" /> Around the same time, Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;the public persona of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&mdash;manipulated [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] into secretly placing an order for the creation of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]] with the [[Clone Master/Legends|cloners]] on Kamino.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Due to the Kaminoans' preference for isolation and Lama Su's own limited understanding of the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name="db" /> the Prime Minister never considered the consequences that a new pan-galactic [[Republic Military/Legends|military force]] would have on the future.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Instead, Lama Su saw the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] proposal as a business opportunity with advantages for Kamino's economy.<ref name="db" />

Over the next decade, Lama Su and his [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] developed the first generation of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], all based on the [[DNA/Legends|genetic code]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Aside from his role as a [[Clone template/Legends|template]], Fett also assisted Lama Su as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], and the two closely monitored the training of the clones.<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> During the development phase of the clone army, Lama Su ordered the cloners to heavily modify the clone subjects in accordance with his instructions to engineer [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] programmed with absolute loyalty. The Prime Minister saw to it that the clones were made with greater docility and a diminished sense of individuality. Through such modifications, Lama Su was confident that the army as a whole would be completely subservient; capable of obeying any order without question.<ref name="EpisodeII" />

[[File:Military_Complex.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lama Su and Taun We guiding Obi-Wan Kenobi on an inspection tour of Kamino's clone units.]]
When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited Kamino in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Lama Su and [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]] assumed that he came to inspect the progress of the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. The Prime Minister assured Kenobi that the project proceeded on schedule, and that the first two-hundred thousand combat-ready [[unit]]s would be joined by a million more clones in the imminent future.<ref name="EpisodeII" /> In his eagerness to impress his Jedi guest with a tour of Kamino's creations, Lama Su overlooked Kenobi's apparent ignorance of the cloning project.<ref name="db" /> Shortly after Kenobi's reported his findings to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] organized Lama Su's clone troopers into the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and placed them under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]]. With the formation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic deployed its clone forces against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], thus initiating the galaxy-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EpisodeII" />

Around the first year of the war, Su was present when Kenobi returned to Kamino to [[Mission to Kamino (Obi-Wan Kenobi)|stop]] the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] bounty hunter, [[Vianna D'Pow]], from stealing Fett's cloning DNA template.<ref name="cwa8">{{CWACite|8|One of a Kind (comic story)}}</ref> During the [[First Battle of Kamino|first Separatist invasion of Kamino]], Lama Su coordinated the planet's defense with the Jedi's support. After enemy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] breached Tipoca City's outer security perimeter, Lama Su activated a batch of [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha''-class Advanced Recon Commandos]]&mdash;also known as [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]]&mdash;to protect the facility's cloning assets.<ref name="Republic50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>

Jango Fett's death at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the Clone Wars<ref name="EpisodeII" /> left the Kaminoans with a limited supply of genetic samples.<ref name="cc">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> They were forced to adopt alternative strategies in order to continue the production of clone troopers, such as breeding new clones from the DNA of existing clones.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Lama Su was less than impressed by some of the younger clone generations, and so he recommended to Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] that a new template would have to be selected if the Jedi hoped to maintain an army of efficient troopers.<ref name="cc" />

Su later went with Shaak Ti to welcome Obi-Wan Kenobi, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to Tipoca [[City/Legends|City]]. The prime minister was surprised to learn that the Confederacy of Independent Systems intended to [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attack]] Kamino, despite the Republic Military blockade that surrounded his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. In preparation for the coming battle, Su positioned himself within Tipoca City's central command center.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

Near the end of the Clone Wars, Su was approached by [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]], who informed him that [[Order 66/Legends|Protocol 66]] had activated prematurely in the clone trooper [[Tup/Legends|CT-5385]]. Su contacted [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus to share this news with him and was ordered to terminate the defective clone so an autopsy could be performed on his body. He was also instructed to remove the clone's bio-chip and send it to Tyranus before the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] could discover the true nature of the chip.<ref name="Conspiracy" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Chancellor Palpatine commissioned the creation of cloning centers on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The new facilities differed from their Kaminoan counterparts in two fundamental ways: they were staffed by [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]]'s scientists, and they utilized [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s that could engineer battle-ready clone soldiers in one year instead of a decade. By that time, Lama Su no longer trusted the intentions of Chancellor Palpatine and believed he would one day marshal his forces against Kamino to destroy them. To defend his world, he discreetly prevented some of the clone units from being absorbed into the Grand Army.<ref name="Order66" />

In the aftermath of the Clone Wars, most of the Jedi were betrayed and murdered by their clone troopers after Chancellor Palpatine&mdash;the public guise of the Sith Lord Darth Sidious&mdash;declared all Jedi as enemies of the Republic. Lama Su's clone army was ultimately a pivotal factor not only in the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Sith plot]] for revenge against the Jedi Order, but also in Palpatine's rise to power as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EpisodeIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> The Kaminoans' efforts against the Empire were crushed in the [[Kamino uprising]].<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You Jedi show too much compassion.|Lama Su|<ref name="cc" />}}
[[File:Lama_Su_battle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lama Su regarded clone troopers as examples of the Kaminoans' cloning skills.]]
Lama Su was fiercely proud of his world's achievements in the science of cloning, the major exporting good that was vital to Kamino's economy.<ref name="db" /> His people's reputation as expert cloners was important to him, and thus it was Lama Su's imperative to ensure that Kamino produced clones of the highest quality;<ref name="EpisodeII" /> genetic failures were completely unacceptable to him. With the exception of several unstable units,<ref name="TripleZero" /> Lama Su regarded the clone troopers as some of Kamino's finest products,<ref name="EpisodeII" /> as well as a testament to the ingenuity of those who served under his employ.<ref name="db" /> The pride he felt in the Kaminoans' reputation was magnified by the combat training and education programs that they utilized to create efficient soldiers for the Galactic Republic.<ref name="EpisodeII" />

Although Lama Su had interactions with offworlders through his capacity as Prime Minister, he hardly possessed a worldly nature, and thus he only had a limited understanding of galactic affairs or Human behavior. As such, he was unconcerned with the purpose of the Republic's clone army.<ref name="db" /> Their creation was a business deal to him,<ref name="NEGTC" /> and so he treated the matter as a merchant-client relationship; Kamino was hired to build a military for the Republic, and Lama Su intended to honor that transaction in exchange for a considerable amount of credits.<ref name="EpisodeII" />

The clones themselves were of great importance to Lama Su,<ref name="db" /><ref name="EpisodeII" /> although not in the same sense as the Jedi who developed an affinity for them.<ref name="cc" /> He was pleased that the clone troopers existed because of the skills and accomplishments of his people and while he did regard them as a magnificent accomplishment on Kamino's part, Lama Su ultimately saw the clones as valuable export products with highly profitable military applications.<ref name="EpisodeII" /> Some Jedi officers developed close bonds with their clone soldiers, but Lama Su neither shared or cared for the Jedi's sense of compassion.<ref name="cc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lama Su was a computer-generated character voiced by [[Anthony Phelan]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="EpisodeII" /> The character's name is pronounced similar to [[Wikipedia:Lamassu|Lamassu]], an [[Wikipedia:Assyria|Assyrian]] protective [[Deity/Legends|deity]]. He was voiced by [[Bob Bergen]] in his appearance in the CGI [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="Clone Cadets Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref>

Originally, Lama Su was intended to be a female character, but was changed to male at the last second.<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
